title: Why Tandem Skydiving

services.desc: At Skydive Long Island™, we strive to provide each of our guests with a first-class tandem skydiving experience. We value your business and don't want cost to stand in the way of you experiencing the best skydiving Long Island has to offer which is why we offer the area's most competitive tandem skydiving near me prices. When you skydive at Skydive Long Island™, you'll jump with a highly experienced, professional instructor and enjoy breathtaking views of Long Island's North and South Forks, Westhampton Beach, the Atlantic Ocean and Fire Island. On clear days, you can see out to Montauk and into New York City! So why wait any longer? Book your Long Island skydive today and get ready for the
